Expand and Knit Per-Domain Child Templates With Failure Isolation (E4)

Source: R/nested_survival_run.R
domain_children.Rd

Loops over `domains`, expands a child Quarto (`.qmd`) or R Markdown (`.Rmd`) template for each domain using [knitr::knit_expand()], and evaluates each child in its own isolated environment via [knitr::knit_child()]. If a domain fails (when `on_error = "continue"`), the error is caught, logged in the returned status table, and rendered as a structured warning callout so remaining domains continue to compile cleanly.

Usage

domain_children(
  domains,
  child,
  ...,
  envir = parent.frame(),
  on_error = c("continue", "stop"),
  quiet = TRUE
)

Arguments

domains

Character vector of domain names (or a named list of per-domain parameter lists).

child

Path to a child `.qmd` / `.Rmd` file, or a character string containing inline child template text.

...

Additional template variables passed to [knitr::knit_expand()] and bound in each domain's child evaluation environment.

envir

Parent environment for child evaluation (defaults to [parent.frame()]). Each domain executes in `new.env(parent = envir)` so variables created in one domain never leak into or overwrite another.

on_error

Behavior when a domain child errors: `"continue"` (default; records the failure, emits a warning, and continues with remaining domains) or `"stop"` (stops immediately).

quiet

Logical (default `TRUE`). Passed to [knitr::knit_child()].

Value

A character object of class `c("cbe_domain_children", "knit_asis", "character")` containing the combined knitted output across domains, with attributes and `$` accessors:

`status`

Tibble with columns `domain`, `status` (`"succeeded"` or `"failed"`), `error`, `duration_sec`, and `output`.

`failed_domains`

Character vector of domain names that failed.

`succeeded_domains`

Character vector of domain names that succeeded.

Details

Inside the child template, the current domain is available both as the {{domain}} [knitr::knit_expand()] placeholder and as the `domain` variable in the child evaluation environment (`envir`). Any additional named arguments in `...` are passed to [knitr::knit_expand()] and bound in the child's environment (if a named argument has the same length as `domains` or is named by `domains`, each domain receives its corresponding element).

See also

[repro_appendix()], [nested_survival_run()], [render_pipeline()]
